stem.text: PQR and XYZ are wires in a circuit. A galvanometer connects Q and Y as a null indicator.

stem.alt: Two horizontal wires: the upper wire is labelled P, Q and R from left to right; the lower wire is labelled X, Y and Z from left to right. A circle containing an arrow, the galvanometer symbol, is drawn vertically between Q on the upper wire and Y on the lower wire, with a dot at each end of the connection.

stem.text: When the galvanometer reads zero, which statement is correct?

A.text: The potential difference between Q and Y is infinite.

B.text: The potential difference between Q and Y is zero.

C.text: The resistance between Q and Y is infinite.

D.text: The resistance between Q and Y is zero.
